episodes.title: A Celestial Event
episodes.summary: When a woman fatally falls from El Capitan, special agent Kyle Turner suspects it wasn't an accident — and that the truth may lie deep within Yosemite.

episodes.title: Jane Doe
episodes.summary: The mystery around Jane Doe deepens as Turner and Vasquez investigate a strange symbol and visit a remote encampment in the woods.

episodes.title: El-o'-win
episodes.summary: Jane Doe's identity raises new questions about the life she left behind — and connects to an old case that has haunted Turner for years.

episodes.title: Gold Rush
episodes.summary: A grim discovery in the mines makes Turner question the squatters' role in the case. Vasquez fights to protect her son when his father reappears.

episodes.title: Terces
episodes.summary: Turner takes the investigation to new extremes — with serious repercussions. Jill gets caught up in Vasquez's conflict with her ex.

episodes.title: All Trails Lead Here
episodes.summary: As the investigation comes to a close, Turner discovers the truth about Lucy's death — and the long-buried secrets that set it in motion.
